name: Patrick Pérez

affiliations.role: VP of AI and Scientific Director

bio: Patrick Pérez is chief executive officer of Kyutai, a non-profit open-science AI lab in Paris. Before Kyutai, Pérez was vice president and scientific director for AI at the automotive supplier Valeo from 2018 to 2023. At Kyutai, Pérez co-authored the technical report on Moshi, a real-time speech-text foundation model released in 2024.
known_for: CEO of Kyutai open-science AI lab
Co-author of the Moshi speech-text model
Former AI scientific director at Valeo
